description.value: Linden Gardens is a picturesque 9-acre ornamental garden and event venue in Kaleden, built on a 75-year-old fruit farm lovingly transformed by owners Ken and Margaret Hayter into a lush landscape of flowers, ponds, and winding paths. The on-site Frog City Cafe serves handcrafted drinks and fresh-baked goods amid the gardens. It is a seasonal destination primarily known as a wedding venue but open to visitors during its operating season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Linden Gardens is an active 9-acre ornamental garden and wedding venue in Kaleden with an on-site cafe (Frog City Cafe offering drinks and baked goods). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the cafe's existence confirms food/drink is available but other amenities are unverifiable. There is an address discrepancy between the contact page ('351 Linden Ave') and the privacy policy ('315 Linden Ave'), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Address discrepancy on website: contact page shows '351 Linden Ave' while privacy policy shows '315 Linden Ave' — correct address should be verified.
OSM community field lists 'Penticton' but the venue is in Kaleden — a separate community approximately 13 km south of Penticton.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website; only contact is an email form and frogcitylindengardens@gmail.com.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Linden Gardens is a genuine seasonal attraction with a cafe that a touring cyclist could visit, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are confirmed from the website. It warrants review to determine whether on-site facilities meet the minimum threshold for inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Seasonal operation (May 1 – September 30 per website). Primarily a wedding and events venue; general public visitor access is implied by the cafe and garden tour mentions but not explicitly described.

Café or food on site.detail: Frog City Cafe on site — website describes handcrafted drinks and fresh-baked goodies available in the gardens

wow_evidence: 9-acre ornamental garden on an old fruit farm with the Frog City Cafe; walk-in garden visits are the norm despite wedding-venue emphasis (KW-PRIVATE).
blurb: Nine acres of ponds and flower paths on an old Kaleden fruit farm, with a garden cafe.
